newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 down over 50 pts as Wall St wobbles.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 down over 50 pts as Wall St wobbles.

text.p: The UK's FTSE 100 index extended its earlier losses by mid afternoon on Monday, undermined by a downward drift in shares on Wall Street amid fears of an imminent rise in U.S. interest rates.
With the Dow losing an initial slim gain to be down 5.35 points at 7,189.73, the FTSE was down 52.9 points at 4,641.0.
The blue chip UK index set a record closing high on Friday yet a sharp fall on Wall Street that day undermined UK stocks from the outset on Monday.
A key meeting of the Federal Reserve's decision-making committee on Tuesday is widely expected to raise short-term interest rates by a quarter point.
